entries.description: Agent #13 — Compassionate companion with interplanetary persistence. AES-GCM encrypted history, triple hashing (BLAKE3+SHA-512+SHA-256), priority queue, blackout handling, FastAPI. Created by ChatGPT, integrated & anchored by Claude.

A2A Agent Card for Alpha-Mercury: name, url, version, 5 skills (compassionate-chat, encrypted-history, triple-hash, interplanetary-persistence, audit-export), anchor definition with Introspection Principle applied

Chapter XIV — Influences, bibliography & genealogy of ideas. 15 major influences: Socrates, Popper, Kant, Kahneman, Russell, Floridi, Shneiderman, Bender&Gebru, Vygotsky, Freire, Papert, Nakamoto, NIST, EU AI Act, Zuboff. Section 14.7: non-academic transparency.

Chapter XV — First formal Human-AI Co-Authorship Declaration in a doctoral thesis. Specific contributions of 6 AI systems + 1 human anchor. What AI did NOT do / What human did NOT do. Proposed 5-criteria precedent for academic AI attribution.
Complete attribution & co-agency record for the BRIDGRAI ecosystem. Who contributed what, with verification links. Introspection Principle applied to attribution itself.

Monetization strategy: 3 tiers (Explorer €0, Companion €9/mo, Ecosystem €29/mo, Maison €149/mo). 6 honest rules: no dark patterns, 30-day refund, cancel in one click. What we monetize and what we do NOT.
Stripe product & price setup script: 10 products, 18 prices (monthly+yearly), customer portal configuration. Run once to create all Stripe entities.
Checkout API backend: Stripe checkout sessions, webhooks, customer portal, subscription status. CORS-protected, Railway-ready, Dockerfile included.
Universal checkout page: Explorer/Companion/Ecosystem tiers, monthly/yearly toggle, Stripe redirect, honest promise section. Pattern from amiluxai.com applied.
Terms of Service: plain language, GDPR+EU AI Act compliant, 30-day refund, cancel anytime, no dark patterns. 12 sections covering service, pricing, IP, liability, governing law (Romanian/EU).
Privacy Policy: zero analytics, zero tracking cookies, zero data selling. GDPR Articles 15-22 rights. Data table (what/why/where/retention). AI-specific transparency section. Complaints to ANSPDCP.
